name: Hobaiah
title: Priest with unverified lineage
summary: Hobaiah was a priest who returned from the Babylonian exile to Jerusalem, but could not prove his priestly ancestry through the genealogical records. He was therefore excluded from priestly service until a priest could consult God using the Urim and Thummim.

keyEvents.title: Return from Exile
keyEvents.description: Hobaiah was among the priests who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem along with Zerubbabel and the other returning Jews.

keyEvents.title: Missing Genealogical Record
keyEvents.description: Hobaiah could not find his genealogy among the priestly family lists, which cast doubt on his right to serve as a priest.

keyEvents.title: Exclusion from Priestly Service
keyEvents.description: Due to lack of documentation of his priestly ancestry, Hobaiah was considered unclean and excluded from eating the most holy things until a priest could appear with the Urim and Thummim.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Nehemiah's list
keyEvents.description: Hobaja is also mentioned in the book of Nehemiah in a similar list of priests who could not prove their lineage, confirming the account from the book of Ezra.
